locator.text: Display 31.5, p. 31, in the proof of Lemma 4.5

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Every ingredient of the display is present, but the paper's two-sided root formula is split in Lean. The minus branch is a definition body: coneBound P J = P + J^2/4 - |J|*sqrt((P-2)/2 + J^2/16) is literally v_-, term for term (same constants 4, 2, 16, the same absolute value on J, the same radicand). The plus branch is never named; it occurs only as the expression `P + J ^ 2 / 4 - v + rootTerm P J` inside the proof of true_cone_iff (ConeAlgebra.lean:83). Nor does any declaration say in words 'v_pm are the roots'; that content is carried by the completed-square identity. Recovery, in full: by rootTerm_sq (which needs 2 < P, exactly the paper's range: 'Both conditions ... imply P_c > 2') rootTerm P J ^ 2 = J^2*((P-2)/2 + J^2/16), so square_difference reads (P + J^2/4 - v)^2 - rootTerm^2 = (P-v)^2 - (v-2)*J^2/2, i.e. (v_- - v)*(v_+ - v) = (1/2)*(2*(P-v)^2 - (v-2)*J^2) with v_pm = P + J^2/4 ± rootTerm P J. Hence v_pm are precisely the roots of the paper's polynomial 2(P_c-v)^2 - (v-2)J_c^2, which is the display. I checked the paper's formula independently by solving that quadratic: v = ((4P+J^2) ± sqrt(8PJ^2 + J^4 - 16J^2))/4 = P + J^2/4 ± |J|sqrt((P-2)/2 + J^2/16).
